tools.name: meld_resolve
tools.description: Append a reply on the same bridge. The first reply sets 24 hours. Each later reply resets 24 hours.

tools.name: meld_read
tools.description: Read a live bridge by code. The code is the capability. This read does not move the clock.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "meld.mergeinc.workers.dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: meld_create · Private data: meld_create · Public sink: meld_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: meld_create · Private data: meld_create · Public sink: meld_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "meld_create" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
